_about: Compiled crates exempted from cargo-vet audit with a dated reason. `xtask vet-guard` fails CI when an exempted crate is compiled without a live row here, and when a row expires. Rows are retired by an audit (ours or imported), never by extending the date without a new reason.

xtask.why: No safe-to-deploy root in any import set (Google's full audits are safe-to-run; Mozilla and ISRG hold deltas only). Compiled into xtask. Under OSS-Fuzz continuous fuzzing. Audit in sittings or adopt an imported root before expiry.
xtask.author: bgonz808

xtask.why: No safe-to-deploy chain reaching 2.8.x (Mozilla delta ends 2.7.4; Google audits are safe-to-run). Compiled into xtask. In-repo fuzz targets upstream. Same plan.
xtask.author: bgonz808
